avis.titre: Peptides are so important and this product shows i
avis.texte: I love love, love, peptide products because peptides are one of those skincare ingredients that actually support how the skin functions. Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as signaling molecules in the skin. Essentially, they tell the skin to perform certain tasks like supporting collagen, production or improving the skin barrier. As we age, collagen production naturally slows down which contributes to loss of firmness in elasticity. Peptide formulas help signal the skin to maintain those structural proteins. This cream is designed to help plump the skin and improve the appearance of fine lines by supporting hydration and collagen structure. The texture feels rich and cushioning without being overly heavy. Products like this work best with consistent use overtime because peptides are supporting the skins long-term structure rather than giving a quick temporary effect. Hence the reason I love it so much.
